g.text: Two places to put the lookup
Client does the load balancing. One less hop, and every
Clients stay dumb — they just call a stable name. Kubernetes
Instances self-register on boot and deregister on shutdown —
but a crashed instance deregisters nothing.
So the registry health-checks, and evicts what stops answering.
DNS already does this. The problem is TTL: clients cache an
address past the point the instance is gone, and many ignore
